verdict.rationale: Many verbatim text excerpts were captured from several ised-isde.canada.ca guidance pages (how-incorporate-business, services-fees-and-processing-times, annual-return, the landing page), which implies the public reading surface serves readable content rather than a JS-only shell. However, no probe documents a keyless, identified-user-agent fetch of those pages, or confirms the absence of a bot wall or CAPTCHA. The only probe hit open.canada.ca's CKAN API, a separate surface that cannot be credited to the registry's guidance pages. Missing for 10: a direct keyless probe of the guidance pages with a standard identified user agent (HTTP status, server-rendered HTML), explicit confirmation of no bot wall or CAPTCHA, and independent corroboration of agent access.
